verdict.headline: Amazon's biggest cloud quarter in years carries stocks to their fourth straight winning month
verdict.label: HOLD — SPX 7,490 posts second consecutive close above 7,380, formally completing the BEARISH regime reversal; AMZN +15% on decade-best AWS quarter offsets AAPL −8% on China and services misses; 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high), September hike at 82.4%, and Brent at $91 leave 4 of 6 regime indicators breached entering August
verdict.rationale_short: Amazon's 15% session — its largest single-day gain in over a decade — drove S&P 500 to 7,490 for a second consecutive close above 7,380, formally completing the two-close BEARISH regime reversal. The FOMC held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% at its July 28-29 meeting in a 9-3 vote (dissenters: Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) against a Trump-pressure hike, but September hike probability is now at 82.4% after the Q2 Employment Cost Index printed 0.9% QoQ — in-line with consensus, which the bond market treated as insufficient relief; 30Y closed at 5.28%, a new 19-year high. Apple fell 8%+ after missing simultaneously on services ($30.74B vs $31.22B est), China revenue ($18.82B vs $19.67B est), and Q4 guidance (+9-11% vs >12% consensus) — the three decision gates flagged in prior briefings. BTC tested near Gate 2 ($62,000) intraday (low $62,369) before recovering to ~$62,929 at the equity close; down ~2.9% on the day but finished July up ~7.5% for the month. July NFP on August 7 is the next regime-critical event. The read holds only if SPX does not close below 7,380.

trade_setups.thesis: Two consecutive closes above 7,380 formally completed the BEARISH regime reversal as of Friday July 31. The level that maintains the reversal: sustained closes above 7,380. Any close below 7,380 re-activates the formal BEARISH regime. PLTR earnings AH Monday August 3 and July NFP August 7 are the two nearest catalysts to test this level.
trade_setups.entry: 7,380 is new support; 7,500+ sustained through NFP signals August momentum
trade_setups.invalidation: Any close below 7,380 re-activates the formal BEARISH regime designation

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high) moved +16bps on a day when ECI printed in-line at 0.9% — the rate move is policy-pricing-driven, not data-driven. FOMC held 3.50-3.75% on July 29 with a 9-3 dissent (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan voted for a hike); September probability is now at 82.4%. July NFP (August 7) is the nearest catalyst; August 13 CPI is second. The level that clears the formal breach: 30Y below 5.00% after a weak NFP print.

bear_case: The two-close SPX reversal is mechanical, not fundamental: the market reclaimed 7,380 on one week of Big Tech earnings — MSFT and AMZN — not on a macro shift. September hike probability at 82.4% is fixed-income's clearest signal of where policy is heading, and a 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high) historically compresses Nasdaq forward multiples over a 3-6 month lag. The FOMC's 9-3 dissent (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) is a policy signal that the hawks are close to winning. AAPL's structural miss and AMD's underperformance on a broad rally day signal rate pressure is already differentiating winners. BTC tested near Gate 2 ($62,000) intraday on July 31 (low $62,369); a weekend close below $62,000 is the first crypto risk signal. If August 7 NFP prints above 150k, September becomes near-certain, 30Y extends toward 5.40%, and SPX loses 7,380 on Day 1 of August. The read no longer holds if SPX closes below 7,380.
